description: Oil and Gas Engineering Projects (Public Version) is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by British Columbia Energy Regulator. Energy Regulator Engineering Project approvals may be issued, upon application, under the authority of Section 100 of the Drilling and Production Regulation or Section 97 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act, depending on project type. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher British Columbia Energy Regulator. Its tags are BC, BC Energy Regulator, BCER, Energy Regulator, Northeast. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
